```
1345	// AI_110 双足翼龙 Betsy 551（NPC.cs:43165 → AI_110_Betsy :62266）
1346	// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
1347	export function betsyAI(e: Enemy, game: GameHooks, player: Player | null) {
1348	  if (!e.bInit) { e.bInit = true; e.ai0 = 0; e.ai1 = 0; e.ai2 = 0; e.ai3 = 0; }
1349	  const x = dd2LocalAI(e);
1350	  e.despawnTimer = 750;   // netAlways：不入 CheckActive 消退
1351	  // 常量（:62277-62318）
1352	  const DMG_BREATH = 35, DMG_FIREBALL = 35;
1353	  const INTRO_T = 10, FLY_ACC = 0.45, FLY_SPD = 7.5;
1354	  const HOVER_T = 30, WIND_T = 30, DIVE_SPD = 23;
1355	  const FLAME_OFF = 600, FLAME_APPR = 12, FLAME_T0 = 40, FLAME_T1 = 80;
1356	  const BOMB_OFF = 1500, BOMB_APR_T = 60, BOMB_ACC = 1 / 30, BOMB_SPD = 12;
1357	  const FIREBALL_EVERY = 10, FIREBALL_N = 6 * FIREBALL_EVERY, TAIL_T = 60;
1358	  const BOMB_TOTAL = BOMB_APR_T + FIREBALL_N + TAIL_T;
1359	  const SPIN_T = 60, SPIN_RATE = TAU / SPIN_T, SPIN_RISE = 0.1, SKYDIVE_SPD = 32;
1360	  const SUMMON_T = 90, SUMMON_AT = 20;
1361	  // ---- 索敌（:62276 NPCUtils.TargetClosestBetsy）：水晶优先,否则玩家 ----
1362	  const tgt = dd2Target(game, e, player);
1363	  if (!tgt) {
1364	    e.vy -= 0.05;
1365	    fly(e);
1366	    return;
1367	  }
1368	  const txc = tgt.x, tyc = tgt.y;
1369	  let timeScale = 1;   // num2：各态动画步进倍率
1370	  if (e.ai0 === 0) {
1371	    // ---- 入场（:62321-62330） ----
1372	    e.ai1 += 1;
1373	    if (e.ai1 >= INTRO_T) { e.ai1 = 0; e.ai0 = 1; e.ai2 = 0; }
1374	  } else if (e.ai0 === 1) {
1375	    // ---- 悬停选招（:62332-62416） ----
1376	    if (e.ai2 === 0) e.ai2 = e.cx < txc ? 1 : -1;
1377	    const destX = txc - e.ai2 * 300, destY = tyc - 200;
1378	    const d = dirTo(e, destX, destY);
1379	    simpleFlyMove(e, d.x * FLY_SPD, d.y * FLY_SPD, FLY_ACC);
1380	    e.facing = e.cx < txc ? 1 : -1;
1381	    e.ai1 += 1;
1382	    if (e.ai1 >= HOVER_T) {
1383	      // ai[3]==5 且 1/3 概率 → 追加一轮（:62344-62347）
1384	      if (e.ai3 === 5 && rnd(3) === 0) e.ai3 += 1;
1385	      let next = 1;                                  // :62349-62370 八槽表
1386	      const s = e.ai3 | 0;
1387	      if (s === 0 || s === 1 || s === 3) next = 2;
1388	      else if (s === 2) next = 3;
1389	      else if (s === 4) next = 4;
1390	      else if (s === 5) next = 5;
1391	      else if (s === 6) next = 3;
1392	      else if (s === 7) next = 6;
1393	      e.ai0 = next;
1394	      e.ai1 = 0; e.ai2 = 0;
1395	      e.ai3 += 1;
1396	      if (e.ai3 >= 8) e.ai3 = 0;
1397	      if (next === 2 || next === 5) {
1398	        // 直冲起手（:62373-62400）：朝目标 23/32 速,rotation 对准
1399	        const v = dirTo(e, txc, tyc);
1400	        e.facing = v.x > 0 ? 1 : -1;
1401	        e.visAngle = Math.atan2(v.y, v.x) + (e.facing === -1 ? Math.PI : 0);
1402	        e.vx = v.x * (next === 2 ? DIVE_SPD : SKYDIVE_SPD);
1403	        e.vy = v.y * (next === 2 ? DIVE_SPD : SKYDIVE_SPD);
1404	      } else if (next === 3) {
1405	        // 火焰吐息起手（:62402-62408）：反向 2 速退位
1406	        const d3 = txc > e.cx ? 1 : -1;
1407	        e.facing = d3;
1408	        e.vx = -2 * d3;
1409	        e.vy = 0;
1410	      }
1411	    }
1412	  } else if (e.ai0 === 2) {
1413	    // ---- 风压冲（:62418-62427） ----
1414	    if (e.ai1 === 0) game.playSfxFiles(soundTrackFiles('dd2_betsy_wind_attack'), 0.7, e.cx, e.cy); // DD2_BetsyWindAttack（:62415）
1415	    e.ai1 += 1;
1416	    if (e.ai1 >= WIND_T) { e.ai0 = 1; e.ai1 = 0; e.ai2 = 0; }
1417	  } else if (e.ai0 === 3) {
1418	    // ---- 火焰吐息（:62429-62487） ----
1419	    e.ai1 += 1;
1420	    e.ai2 = e.cx < txc ? 1 : -1;
1421	    if (e.ai1 < FLAME_T0) {
1422	      // 接位：目标反向 600px 上空（:62435-62447）
1423	      const dx = txc - e.ai2 * FLAME_OFF, dy = tyc - 250;
1424	      const d = dirTo(e, dx, dy);
1425	      if (Math.hypot(dx - e.cx, dy - e.cy) < FLAME_APPR) {
1426	        e.x = dx - e.w / 2; e.y = dy - e.h / 2;   // 原版 base.Center = vector4 直接贴位
1427	      } else {
1428	        e.x += d.x * FLAME_APPR;
1429	        e.y += d.y * FLAME_APPR;
1430	      }
1431	      if (Math.hypot(dx - e.cx, dy - e.cy) < 16) e.ai1 = FLAME_T0 - 1;
1432	      timeScale = 1.5;
1433	    }
1434	    if (e.ai1 === FLAME_T0) {
1435	      // 喷焰起手（:62449-62461）：10 速横冲 + 687 喷焰
1436	      const d3 = txc > e.cx ? 1 : -1;
1437	      e.vx = d3 * 10;
1438	      e.vy = 0;
1439	      e.facing = d3;
1440	      shootD(game, e.cx, e.cy, e.vx, e.vy, DMG_BREATH, 687, 300, 0, 20);
1441	      game.playSfxFiles(['dd2_betsy_flame_breath'], 0.7, e.cx, e.cy);   // DD2_BetsyFlameBreath（:62462）
1442	    }
1443	    if (e.ai1 >= FLAME_T0) {
1444	      timeScale = 1.5;
1445	      if (Math.abs(txc - e.cx) > 550 && Math.abs(e.vx) < 20) {
1446	        e.vx += sign(e.vx) * 0.5;                  // 远距提速（:62465-62469）
1447	      }
1448	    }
1449	    if (e.ai1 >= FLAME_T0 + FLAME_T1) { e.ai0 = 1; e.ai1 = 0; e.ai2 = 0; }
1450	  } else if (e.ai0 === 4) {
1451	    // ---- 空袭（:62489-62583） ----
1452	    e.ai2 = e.cx < txc ? 1 : -1;
1453	    if (e.ai1 < BOMB_APR_T) {
1454	      // 高位接位（:62493-62509）：反向 1500px、-350 上空
1455	      const dx = txc - e.ai2 * BOMB_OFF, dy = tyc - 350;
1456	      const d = dirTo(e, dx, dy);
1457	      e.vx = lerp(e.vx, d.x * BOMB_SPD, BOMB_ACC);
1458	      e.vy = lerp(e.vy, d.y * BOMB_SPD, BOMB_ACC);
1459	      e.facing = e.cx < txc ? 1 : -1;
1460	      if (Math.hypot(dx - e.cx, dy - e.cy) < 16) e.ai1 = BOMB_APR_T - 1;
1461	      timeScale = 1.5;
1462	    } else if (e.ai1 === BOMB_APR_T) {
1463	      // 俯冲突进（:62511-62521）：12 速贴地掠射
1464	      let v = dirTo(e, txc, tyc);
1465	      v = { x: v.x, y: v.y * 0.25 };
1466	      const vl = Math.hypot(v.x, v.y) || 1;
1467	      v = { x: v.x / vl, y: v.y / vl };
1468	      e.facing = v.x > 0 ? 1 : -1;
1469	      e.visAngle = Math.atan2(v.y, v.x) + (e.facing === -1 ? Math.PI : 0);
1470	      e.vx = v.x * BOMB_SPD;
1471	      e.vy = v.y * BOMB_SPD;
1472	    } else {
1473	      // 掠射（:62523-62543）：水平 7/t、垂直 6/t 贴地,每 10t 投 686 火球 ×6

1475	      e.x += dTo.x * 7;
1476	      e.y += dirTo(e, txc, tyc - 400).y * 6;
1477	      if (e.ai1 <= BOMB_TOTAL - TAIL_T) timeScale = 1.5;
1478	      const ox = (110 + 30) * e.facing, oy = 20;
1479	      const rx = e.cx + ox * Math.cos(e.visAngle) - oy * Math.sin(e.visAngle);
1480	      const ry = e.cy + ox * Math.sin(e.visAngle) + oy * Math.cos(e.visAngle);
1481	      const n = Math.floor(e.ai1 - BOMB_APR_T + 1);
1482	      if (n <= FIREBALL_N && n % FIREBALL_EVERY === 0) {
1483	        shootD(game, rx, ry, e.vx, e.vy, DMG_FIREBALL, 686, 300, 0.08, 3);
1484	      }
1485	    }
1486	    if (e.ai1 > BOMB_TOTAL - TAIL_T) e.vy -= 0.1;   // 尾段拉起（:62545-62547）
1487	    e.ai1 += 1;
1488	    if (e.ai1 >= BOMB_TOTAL) { e.ai0 = 1; e.ai1 = 0; e.ai2 = 0; }
1489	  } else if (e.ai0 === 5) {
1490	    // ---- 翻转俯冲（:62585-62604） ----
1491	    const rot = -SPIN_RATE * e.facing;
1492	    const c = Math.cos(rot), s = Math.sin(rot);
1493	    const nvx = e.vx * c - e.vy * s;
1494	    const nvy = e.vx * s + e.vy * c;
1495	    e.vx = nvx; e.vy = nvy;
1496	    e.y -= SPIN_RISE;
1497	    const d = dirTo(e, txc, tyc);
1498	    e.x += d.x * 10;
1499	    e.y += d.y * 10;
1500	    e.visAngle -= SPIN_RATE * e.facing;
1501	    timeScale *= 0.7;
1502	    if (e.ai1 === 1) game.playSfxFiles(['dd2_betsy_flying_circle_attack'], 0.7, e.cx, e.cy); // DD2_BetsyFlyingCircleAttack（:62547）
1503	    e.ai1 += 1;
1504	    if (e.ai1 >= SPIN_T) {
1505	      e.ai0 = 1; e.ai1 = 0; e.ai2 = 0;
1506	      e.vx /= 2; e.vy /= 2;
1507	    }
1508	  } else if (e.ai0 === 6) {
1509	    // ---- 召唤（:62606-62655） ----
1510	    if (e.ai1 === 0) {
1511	      // 贴水晶上空（:62608-62620）

1513	      simpleFlyMove(e, d.x * FLY_SPD * 2, d.y * FLY_SPD * 2, FLY_ACC * 2);
1514	      e.facing = e.cx < txc ? 1 : -1;
1515	      e.ai2 += 1;
1516	      if (Math.hypot(txc - e.cx, tyc - e.cy) < 350 || e.ai2 >= 180) e.ai1 = 1;
1517	    } else {
1518	      if (e.ai1 === 1) game.playSfxFiles(['dd2_betsy_scream'], 0.8, e.cx, e.cy);  // DD2_BetsyScream（:62577）
1519	      if (e.ai1 < SUMMON_AT) { e.vx *= 0.95; e.vy *= 0.95; }
1520	      else { e.vx *= 0.98; e.vy *= 0.98; }
1521	      if (e.ai1 === SUMMON_AT) {
1522	        if (e.vy > 0) e.vy /= 3;
1523	        e.vy -= 3;                                   // 跃起（:62630-62634）
1524	        game.spawnParticles(e.cx, e.cy + e.h / 2, '#C8A060', 26, 4, { life: 40 });
1525	      }
1526	      timeScale *= 0.85;
1527	      // 召唤窗口（:62657-62696）：场上 560 ≤4 才召;自周 300px 环 + 传送门各出 560
1528	      if (e.ai1 === SUMMON_AT || e.ai1 === 45 || e.ai1 === 70) {

1530	          .filter((n) => !n.dead && n.vanillaId === 560).length;
1531	        if (wyverns <= 4) {
1532	          const a = Math.random() * TAU;
1533	          const sx = e.cx + Math.cos(a) * 2 * 300 * (0.6 + Math.random() * 0.4);
1534	          const sy = e.cy + Math.sin(a) * 1 * 300 * (0.6 + Math.random() * 0.4);

1537	            if (w) { w.x = sx - w.w / 2; w.y = sy - w.h / 2; }

1539	          const portals = (game.enemies() as Enemy[])

1543	            const w = spawnPart(game, e, 560);

1546	          game.playSfxFiles(soundTrackFiles('dd2_betsy_summon'), 0.7, e.cx, e.cy);  // DD2_BetsySummon（:62652/:62671 每召一只一声）

1548	      }
1549	      e.ai1 += 1;

1552	  }
1553	  // ---- 拍翼帧计数（:62657-62666 localAI[0]/[1]） ----

1555	  if (x[0] >= 36) x[0] = 0;
1556	  x[1] += 1;
1557	  if (x[1] >= 60) x[1] = 0;

1559	  const dTo = dirTo(e, txc, tyc);

1563	  if (s0 === 2 || s0 === 5) step = 0;
1564	  else if (s0 === 3) {

1566	    tgtAng = e.facing === -1 ? -Math.PI : 0;
1567	    if (e.ai1 >= FLAME_T0) { tgtAng += e.facing * Math.PI / 12; step = 0.05; }

1570	    tgtAng = e.facing === 1 ? Math.PI * 2 : Math.PI;
1571	  } else if (s0 === 6) {

1574	  }
1575	  if (e.facing === -1) tgtAng += Math.PI;
1576	  if (step !== 0) e.visAngle = angleTowards(e.visAngle, tgtAng, step);

1581	// AI_111 埃特尼亚荧光虫 578（NPC.cs:43169 → AI_111_DD2LightningBug :66799）
1582	// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
1583	export function dd2LightningBugAI(e: Enemy, game: GameHooks, player: Player | null) {
1584	  if (!e.bInit) { e.bInit = true; }
1585	  const x = dd2LocalAI(e);
1586	  // 族参数（:66803-66813 默认档 → :66828-66844 的 578 覆盖）
1587	  const SPEED = 4;            // num
1588	  const LERP_FAR = 20;        // num2
1589	  const LERP_NEAR = 20;       // num3
1590	  const MIN_SPD = 1;          // num4
1591	  const DAMP = 0.96;          // num5
1592	  const SHOOT_T = 5;          // num6
1593	  const COOLDOWN = 30;        // num7
1594	  const RANGE = 200;          // num8
1595	  const ZAP_DMG = 50;         // num9
1596	  const ZAP_PROJ = 682;       // num10
1597	  const ZAP_SPD = 10;         // num11
1598	  const HEIGHT_GATE = 50;     // num12
1599	  const SEP = 0.1;            // num13
1600	  // ---- 出生渐显（:66846-66876 flag3） ----
1601	  if (x[1] === 0) e.spawnAlpha = 255;
1602	  if (x[1] === 30) game.playSfxFiles(soundTrackFiles('dd2_etherian_portal_spawn_enemy'), 0.3, e.cx, e.cy);
1603	  if (x[1] < 60) {
1604	    x[1] += 1;
1605	    e.spawnAlpha = Math.max(0, e.spawnAlpha - 5);
1606	    e.alphaFade = false;
1607	  }
1608	  // ---- 索敌（:66816 TargetClosestOldOnesInvasion） ----
1609	  const tgt = dd2Target(game, e, player);
1610	  // ---- 同族分离（:66878-66900 flag2,cs:66878-66900） ----
1611	  for (const n of game.enemies() as Enemy[]) {
1612	    if (n === e || n.dead || n.vanillaId !== e.vanillaId) continue;
1613	    if (Math.abs(e.x - n.x) + Math.abs(e.y - n.y) < e.w) {
1614	      if (e.x < n.x) e.vx -= SEP; else e.vx += SEP;
1615	      if (e.y < n.y) e.vy -= SEP; else e.vy += SEP;
1616	    }
1617	  }
1618	  e.visAngle = Math.abs(e.vx) * e.facing * 0.1;    // rotation（:66902）
1619	  // ---- 电光尘（:66846-66862 的 272 号尘,粒子近似） ----
1620	  if (Math.random() < 1 / 80) {
1621	    const a = Math.random() * TAU;
1622	    game.spawnParticles(e.cx, e.cy, '#B0E0FF', 2, 0.8, { life: 30 });
1623	    void a;
1624	  }
1625	  if (!tgt) { fly(e); return; }
1626	  const txc = tgt.x, tyc = tgt.y;
1627	  const muzzleX = e.cx - e.facing * 20, muzzleY = e.cy + 10;   // center 偏移（:66841）
1628	  const dx = txc - muzzleX, dy = tyc - muzzleY;
1629	  const dist = Math.hypot(dx, dy) || 1;
1630	  const ux = dx / dist, uy = dy / dist;
1631	  const los = losClear(game, e.cx, e.cy, txc, tyc);
1632	  if (x[0] < 0) x[0] += 1;                          // 冷却回摆（:66911-66912）
1633	  if (dist > RANGE || !los) {
1634	    // ---- 远距/断视：逼近（:66916-66918） ----
1635	    e.vx = (e.vx * (LERP_FAR - 1) + ux * SPEED) / LERP_FAR;
1636	    e.vy = (e.vy * (LERP_FAR - 1) + uy * SPEED) / LERP_FAR;
1637	  } else if (dy < HEIGHT_GATE) {
1638	    // ---- 目标高位差小：微升（:66920-66922） ----
1639	    e.vy -= 0.03;
1640	  } else if (x[0] >= 0) {
1641	    // ---- 静止蓄电（:66924-66946） ----
1642	    e.vx *= DAMP;
1643	    e.vy *= DAMP;
1644	    if (Math.hypot(e.vx, e.vy) < MIN_SPD) {
1645	      x[0] += 1;
1646	      if (x[0] >= SHOOT_T) {
1647	        x[0] = -COOLDOWN;
1648	        e.facing = ux > 0 ? 1 : -1;                 // direction = spriteDirection
1649	        // 速度扰动（:66934-66944）：±25px 抖动 + 两级 ±0.5%/±0.625% 缩放
1650	        let sx = dx + rndRange(-25, 26), sy = dy + rndRange(-25, 26);
1651	        sx *= 1 + rndRange(-20, 21) * 0.005;
1652	        sy *= 1 + rndRange(-20, 21) * 0.005;
1653	        const sl = Math.hypot(sx, sy) || 1;
1654	        sx = (sx / sl) * ZAP_SPD;
1655	        sy = (sy / sl) * ZAP_SPD;
1656	        sx *= 1 + rndRange(-20, 21) * (1 / 160);
1657	        sy *= 1 + rndRange(-20, 21) * (1 / 160);
1658	        shootD(game, muzzleX, muzzleY, sx, sy, ZAP_DMG, ZAP_PROJ, 300, 0, 3);
1659	      }
1660	    }
1661	  }
1662	  // ---- 上浮（:66950-66970）：目标在上或自身埋块 → vy-0.2 钳 -10 ----
1663	  let rise = tyc < e.cy;
1664	  if (!rise) {
1665	    const etx = Math.floor(e.cx / TILE), ety = Math.floor(e.cy / TILE);
1666	    if (solidAt(game, etx, ety)) rise = true;
1667	  }
1668	  if (rise) {
1669	    e.vy -= 0.2;
1670	    if (e.vy < -10) e.vy = -10;
1671	  }
1672	  fly(e);
1673	}

1693	/** GetAttackDamage_ForProjectiles（NPC.cs:7031-7034）：npc.difficulty 在
1694	 *  Classic(1)→Expert(2) 区间的 Utils.Remap（GameDifficultyLevel.cs:7-9;不钳界,
1695	 *  Master=3 外推照录）。Enemy.difficulty 即原版 npc.difficulty（ScaleStats 投影）。 */
1696	function projDmgOf(e: Enemy, normal: number, expert: number): number {
1697	  const t = e.difficulty - GDL.CLASSIC;   // 区间归零:Classic 0 / Expert 1 / Master 2
1698	  return Math.round(normal + (expert - normal) * t);
1699	}

1862	/** AI_107 出膛（cs:64394-64417 flag3 / :64575-64615 flag12 共用弹道） */
1863	function fireWalkerProj(
1864	  game: GameHooks, e: Enemy, p: Walker107P, tx: number, ty: number,
1865	): void {
1866	  const mx = e.cx + p.muzzleDx * e.facing;
1867	  const my = e.cy + (p.muzzleAtBottom ? e.h / 2 - 1 : p.muzzleDy);
1868	  let vx = tx - mx, vy = ty - my;
1869	  vy -= Math.abs(vx) * p.arc;              // 弧线补偿
1870	  const len = Math.hypot(vx, vy) || 1;
1871	  vx = (vx / len) * p.speed;
1872	  vy = (vy / len) * p.speed;
1873	  const sx = mx + vx * p.spawnOffset, sy = my + vy * p.spawnOffset;
1874	  for (let i = 0; i < p.shots; i++) {
1875	    const jx = vx + (Math.random() * 2 - 1) * p.jitter;   // Utils.RandomVector2(±num16)
1876	    const jy = vy + (Math.random() * 2 - 1) * p.jitter;
1877	    if (p.proj === 681) {
1878	      // 681 哥布林炸弹（aiStyle 16,SetDefaults :6984-6991）——引信/反弹/80² 爆盒
1879	      (game as unknown as { entities: { add: (en: unknown, b: string) => void } })
1880	        .entities.add(new DD2GoblinBomb(sx, sy, jx, jy, p.projDmg), 'projectiles');
1881	    } else if (p.proj === 683) {
1882	      // 683 食人魔跺地波（aiStyle 135,SetDefaults :7003+）——原地 80→640 扩盒
1883	      (game as unknown as { entities: { add: (en: unknown, b: string) => void } })
1884	        .entities.add(new DD2OgreSmash(sx, sy, p.projDmg), 'projectiles');
1885	    } else {
1886	      // 662/685 标枪、671 德拉肯弹、676 食人魔涎（均 aiStyle 1,:6843/:6907/:6952）
1887	      // ——grav 0.3 抛物线,penetrate -1（Arrow 以大值近似无限穿透）
1888	      shootD(game, sx, sy, jx, jy, p.projDmg, p.proj, 180, 0.3, 999);
1889	    }
1890	  }
1891	}

1893	/** AI_107 目标（NPCUtils.TargetClosestOldOnesInvasion :261-273 + SearchForTarget
1894	 *  :196-259）：水晶 548（!dontTakeDamageFromHostiles）恒候选;200px 内玩家按距夺标 */
1895	interface W107Target { x: number; y: number; w: number; h: number; cx: number; cy: number; }
1896	
1897	function w107Target(game: GameHooks, e: Enemy, player: Player | null): W107Target | null {
1898	  let crystal: Enemy | null = null;
1899	  for (const n of game.enemies() as Enemy[]) {
1900	    if (!n.dead && n.vanillaId === 548 && !n.dontTakeDamage) { crystal = n; break; }
1901	  }
1902	  const pd = player && !player.dead
1903	    ? Math.hypot(player.cx - e.cx, player.cy - e.cy) : Infinity;
1904	  if (crystal) {
1905	    const cd = Math.hypot(crystal.cx - e.cx, crystal.cy - e.cy);
1906	    if (pd <= 200 && pd < cd) {
1907	      return { x: player!.x, y: player!.y, w: player!.w, h: player!.h, cx: player!.cx, cy: player!.cy };
1908	    }
1909	    return { x: crystal.x, y: crystal.y, w: crystal.w, h: crystal.h, cx: crystal.cx, cy: crystal.cy };
1910	  }
1911	  if (pd !== Infinity) {
1912	    return { x: player!.x, y: player!.y, w: player!.w, h: player!.h, cx: player!.cx, cy: player!.cy };
1913	  }
1914	  return null;
1915	}

1917	/** AI_107 走路加速核（:64537-64550 / :64660-64678 同式） */
1918	function w107WalkAccel(e: Enemy, p: Walker107P): void {
1919	  if (e.vx < -p.maxSpd || e.vx > p.maxSpd) {
1920	    if (e.vy === 0) { e.vx *= p.damp; e.vy *= p.damp; }    // velocity *= num25
1921	  } else if ((e.vx < p.maxSpd && e.facing === 1) || (e.vx > -p.maxSpd && e.facing === -1)) {
1922	    e.vx = clamp(e.vx + p.accel * e.facing, -p.maxSpd, p.maxSpd);
1923	  }
1924	}
```

```
/** 声轨名（snake 形，如 'dd2_betsy_wind_attack'）→ 变体组 wav。
 *  AI 侧状态机播音用：playSfxFiles(soundTrackFiles(轨名), vol, x, y) */
export function soundTrackFiles(track: string): string[] {
  const files = SOUND_TRACKS[track];
  return files && files.length ? files : [track];
}

// ================= 生成池（原版生成规则的分期近似，task #13 细化） =================
// 按环境分组：白天地表 / 夜间地表 / 洞穴 / 地狱；肉前常用怪优先
export const VANILLA_SPAWN_POOLS = {
  // 肉前地表白天：蓝/母史莱姆（绿史莱姆走 legacy 50% 路径出）
  daySurface: [1, 16].filter((n) => n > 0),
  // 肉前夜晚地表：僵尸/恶魔眼（噬魂怪只在腐化群系池出）
  nightSurface: [3, 2].filter((n) => n > 0),
  // 肉前洞穴：蝙蝠/骷髅/巨蠕虫/黑暗法师/爬墙蜘蛛——巨蝠93/孢子僵尸254/褴褛法师281 是困难模式，已移除
  underground: [49, 21, 10, 32, 159].filter((n) => n > 0),
  // 地狱：恶魔(62)/巫毒恶魔(66)/火妖(24)；蟹 67 已移到海洋
  hell: [62, 66, 24].filter((n) => n > 0),
  // ---- 群系池（对照原版 SpawnNPC zone 规则的肉前常用怪，AI 家族均已移植） ----
  corruption: [6, 7].filter((n) => n > 0),                                  // 噬魂怪(蜂群5)/吞噬怪(蠕虫6)
  crimson: [173, 223].filter((n) => n > 0),                                // 血蝙蝠(蜂群5)/血腥怪(战士3)
  jungle: [51, 158].filter((n) => n > 0),                                  // 丛林蝙蝠(14)/巨蝠(14)
  snow: [147, 152].filter((n) => n > 0),                                   // 冰史莱姆(1)
  desert: [73, 335].filter((n) => n > 0),                                  // 蚁狮(战士3)/沙史莱姆(1)
  // 水域（仅地表湖泊/海洋；地底水不出怪）：水母/食人鱼/琵琶鱼；海洋追加鲨鱼/蟹
  water: [63, 64, 58, 102, 221].filter((n) => n > 0),
  ocean: [65, 67, 63, 64].filter((n) => n > 0),                            // 鲨鱼(16)/蟹(3)
  // ---- 小动物（CountsAsCritter，白天地表） ----
  critters: [46, 303, 74, 299, 300, 377, 357, 356].filter((n) => n > 0),   // 兔/鸟/松鼠/鼠/蚱蜢/蚯蚓/萤火虫变体
};

/** 探针调试用：非空时 poolFor 恒返回此池（确定性验证生成路径） */
export let debugPoolOverride: number[] | null = null;
export function setDebugPool(pool: number[] | null) { debugPoolOverride = pool; }

/** 按玩家环境取生成池 id 列表。biome：spawn 点地面 tile 判定的群系（Game 传入） */
export function poolFor(groundLevel: number, lavaLine: number, ty: number, isDay: boolean, biome?: string): number[] {
  if (debugPoolOverride) return debugPoolOverride;
  if (ty > lavaLine) return VANILLA_SPAWN_POOLS.hell;
  if (ty > groundLevel + 15) return VANILLA_SPAWN_POOLS.underground;
  if (biome && VANILLA_SPAWN_POOLS[biome as keyof typeof VANILLA_SPAWN_POOLS]) {
    return VANILLA_SPAWN_POOLS[biome as keyof typeof VANILLA_SPAWN_POOLS] as number[];
  }
  return isDay ? VANILLA_SPAWN_POOLS.daySurface : VANILLA_SPAWN_POOLS.nightSurface;
}

```

```
311	    if (e.ai3 >= 3600) { e.ai1 = 0; e.ai2 = 0; e.ai3 = 0; }
312	    else if (inWin === 0 && player) {
313	      let dx = player.cx + e.ai2 * 350 - center.x, dy = player.cy - 250 - center.y;
314	      const d = Math.hypot(dx, dy) || 1;
315	      dx /= d; dy /= d;
316	      e.vx = lerp(e.vx, dx * 16, 0.1); e.vy = lerp(e.vy, dy * 16, 0.1);
317	    } else {
318	      const gap = groundGapPx(game, e);
319	      if (gap < 250) {
320	        const t = 4 > gap ? -gap : -4;
321	        e.vy = lerp(e.vy, t, 0.05);
322	      } else e.vy *= 0.95;
323	      e.vx = 8 * e.ai2;
324	    }
325	    e.visAngle = 0;
326	  }
327	  // ---- 出界钳制 + 消散（:36751-36772）----
328	  const st = game.world.store;
329	  if (e.y < -100 || e.x < -100 || e.y > st.h * TILE + 100 || e.x > st.w * TILE + 100) {
330	    e.x = clamp(e.x, -100, st.w * TILE + 100);
331	    e.y = clamp(e.y, -100, st.h * TILE + 100);
332	    e.dead = true;
333	    return;
334	  }
335	  fly(e);
336	}

339	// AI_075 飞碟部件 392/393/394 + 骑手 390（NPC.cs:35745-36321;416/492 同构锚表一并接）
340	// 锚点偏移（cs:35766/35813/35820/35827）:390→391 (0,-14);392→395 (0,2) 旋转随体;
341	//   393→395 (±60,+29);394→395 (±49,-13),spriteDirection=±1;416→415 (-spriteDir*10,-30)
342	// 主体消亡（:36288-36299）:390→Transform(382) / 416→Transform(518) / 其余消散
343	// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
344	export function martianSaucerPartAI(e: Enemy, game: GameHooks, player: Player | null) {
345	  const id = e.vanillaId ?? 0;
346	  // ---- 荷兰大炮 492（DD2 批 bossAI_dd2.ts：锚船体偏移 cs:35889 + 240t 装填炮击
347	  // cs:36008）——aiStyle 75 分发进本函数,转发后不走飞碟部件路径 ----
348	  if (id === 492) { dutchmanCannonAI(e, game, player); return; }
349	  // ---- 骑手首帧生成坐骑（:35750-35762）----
350	  if ((id === 390 || id === 416) && !e.bInit) {
351	    e.bInit = true;
352	    const mount = spawnPart(game, e, id === 390 ? 391 : 415);
353	    if (mount) e.master = mount;
354	  }
355	  if (!e.bInit && (id === 392 || id === 393 || id === 394)) e.bInit = true;
356	
357	  const mount = e.master;
358	  const mountOk = !!mount && !mount.dead;
359	  if (!mountOk) {
360	    // 主体消亡分支（:36288-36299）
361	    if (id === 390 || id === 416) {
362	      e.transformTo(id === 390 ? 382 : 518, game.world.store, false, game);   // Transform → 下车变步兵
363	    } else {
364	      e.dead = true;   // 部件随主体消散（life=0 + active=false,无掉落）
365	    }
366	    return;
367	  }
368	  const m = mount as Enemy;
369	  // ---- 锚定跟随（:35764-35845 + 36200-36214）：零速贴主体 + 偏移 ----
370	  let ox = 0, oy = 0;
371	  let spriteDir = m.facing;
372	  if (id === 390) { ox = 0; oy = -14; }
373	  else if (id === 392) { ox = 0; oy = 2; }
374	  else if (id === 393) { ox = e.ai1 === 1 ? 60 : -60; oy = 29; }
375	  else if (id === 394) { ox = e.ai1 === 1 ? 49 : -49; oy = -13; spriteDir = e.ai1 === 1 ? 1 : -1; }
376	  else if (id === 416) { ox = -m.facing * 10; oy = -30; }
377	  e.vx = 0; e.vy = 0;
378	  e.x = m.cx - e.w / 2 + ox;
379	  e.y = m.cy - e.h / 2 + oy;
380	  // spriteDirection（394 按 ai[1] 固定侧,其余随主体;:36206-36212）
381	  e.facing = spriteDir === 1 ? 1 : -1;
382	
383	  if (id === 390) {
384	    // ---- 骑手射击（:36216-36280）：ai[1] 冷却 60t(受击 -30),<700px+LOS 朝向对 → 438 弹 ----
385	    e.vx = m.vx;
386	    if (e.ai1 < 60) e.ai1 += 1;
387	    if (e.justHit) e.ai1 = -30;
388	    if (player && !player.dead) {
389	      const dx = player.cx - e.cx, dy = player.cy - e.cy;
390	      const canHit = losClear(game, e.x, e.y, player.x, player.y);
391	      if (canHit && Math.hypot(dx, dy) < 700) {
392	        if (e.ai1 === 60 && sign(dx) === e.facing) {
393	          e.ai1 = -60;
394	          const oxp = e.cx, oyp = e.cy - 4;
395	          let sx = player.cx - oxp, sy = player.cy - oyp;
396	          sx += rndRange(-50, 51); sy += rndRange(-50, 51);
397	          sx *= rndRange(80, 121) * 0.01; sy *= rndRange(80, 121) * 0.01;
398	          const d = Math.hypot(sx, sy);
399	          if (d > 0.001) { sx = (sx / d) * 7; sy = (sy / d) * 7; }
400	          else { sx = 0; sy = -7; }
401	          shootM(game, oxp, oyp, sx, sy, 30, 438);
402	          game.playSfxFiles?.(['Item_39'], 1, e.cx, e.cy);   // :36272 骑手(Scutlix 390)射弹音
403	        }
404	      }
405	    }
406	    return;
407	  }
408	  if (id !== 392 && id !== 393 && id !== 394) return;
409	
410	  // ---- 部件攻击窗（共享 saucer.ai[3] 计数,cs:36128/36171/36235）----
411	  const saucer = m;
412	  e.ai3 = saucer.ai3;
413	  if (id === 394) {
414	    // 火炮窗 [440,580)（:36124-36150）：每 20t 一发 448,朝向 ±22.5° 散布,速 8
415	    if (e.ai3 >= 440 && e.ai3 < 580) {
416	      const n = e.ai3 - 440;
417	      if (n % 20 === 0) {
418	        const dirx = spriteDir;
419	        const delta = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.7853982;   // ±22.5° 散布（:36133-36136）
420	        shootM(game, e.cx + dirx * 36, e.cy + 8,
421	          Math.cos(delta) * 8 * dirx, Math.sin(delta) * 8 * dirx, 50, 448);
422	      }
423	    }
424	    return;
425	  }
426	  if (id === 393) {
427	    // 激光窗 [280,420)（:36152-36197）：窗内每 6t 一发 449 速 16;窗外只瞄准(ai[2] 角)
428	    const inWin = e.ai3 >= 280 && e.ai3 < 420;
429	    if (!inWin && player && !player.dead) {
430	      let dx = player.cx - e.cx, dy = player.cy - e.cy;
431	      if (dy < 0) dy = 0;
432	      const d = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
433	      if (d > 0.001) e.ai2 = Math.atan2(dy / d, dx / d);
434	      else e.ai2 = Math.PI / 2;
435	    }
436	    if (inWin) {
437	      const n = e.ai3 - 280;
438	      if (n % 6 === 0) {
439	        const ang = e.ai2 + (Math.random() - 0.5) * (0.7853982 / 3);
440	        shootM(game, e.cx, e.cy, Math.cos(ang) * 16, Math.sin(ang) * 16, 35, 449);
441	        game.playSfxFiles?.(['Item_12'], 1, e.cx, e.cy);     // :36140 部件激光(392 段 Item12)
442	      }
443	    }
444	    return;
445	  }
446	  // ---- 392 炮体（:36199-36286）----
447	  // 部件全灭检测（:35791-35820）：炮塔/火炮全灭 → 普通模式飞碟 ai0=3 自毁(expert→1)
448	  {
449	    const list = slots.get(e);
450	    const turrets = list ? list.slice(0, 2).filter((p) => !p.dead && p.vanillaId === 393) : [];
451	    const cannons = list ? list.slice(2, 4).filter((p) => !p.dead && p.vanillaId === 394) : [];
452	    let allDead = saucer.ai0 >= 1 || saucer.ai0 < 0 ? false : true;
453	    if (allDead && (turrets.length > 0 || cannons.length > 0)) allDead = false;
454	    if (allDead && saucer.ai0 === 0) {
455	      if (!EXPERT) { saucer.ai0 = 3; saucer.ai1 = 0; saucer.ai2 = 0; saucer.ai3 = 0; }
456	      else { saucer.ai0 = 1; saucer.ai1 = 0; saucer.ai2 = 0; saucer.ai3 = 0; }
457	    }
458	  }
459	  // 死光电报（:36201-36219）：巡航态 ai[3]∈[20,260) 首帧（n==0）→ Projectile 447
460	  if (e.ai3 >= 20 && e.ai3 < 260 && saucer.ai0 === 0) {
461	    if (e.ai3 - 20 === 0) {
462	      // 447 死光电报实体（AI_079）——束体独立类（锚定电报塔/母舰，束高逐tick重算）
463	      const ray = new MartianDeathray(e, 50);
464	      (game as unknown as { entities: { add(el: unknown, b: string): void } }).entities.add(ray, 'projectiles');
465	    }
466	  }
467	  // 空巢发射器（:36221-36279）：窗口内对已灭槽位按概率补射 450 导弹
468	  {
469	    const list = slots.get(e) ?? [];
470	    const t0 = list[0], t1 = list[1], c0 = list[2], c1 = list[3];
471	    const t0Dead = !t0 || t0.dead || t0.vanillaId !== 393;
472	    const t1Dead = !t1 || t1.dead || t1.vanillaId !== 393;
473	    const c0Dead = !c0 || c0.dead || c0.vanillaId !== 394;
474	    const c1Dead = !c1 || c1.dead || c1.vanillaId !== 394;
475	    let flag76 = false, mv4 = 1000, mv5 = 1000;
476	    if (saucer.ai0 === 2) { flag76 = true; mv4 = 120; mv5 = 120; }
477	    if (!flag76 && e.ai3 >= 280 && e.ai3 < 400) { flag76 = true; mv5 = 90; mv4 = 60; }
478	    if (!flag76 && e.ai3 >= 440 && e.ai3 < 580) { flag76 = true; mv5 = 60; mv4 = 90; }
479	    if (flag76) {
480	      // 炮塔空巢（:36243-36258）:下方侧向抛射
481	      if (t0Dead && rnd(mv4) === 0) {
482	        const ang = Math.atan2(1, -Math.random() * 3) + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.7853982;
483	        shootM(game, e.cx - rndRange(50, 70), e.cy + rndRange(30, 45),
484	          Math.cos(ang) * 3, Math.sin(ang) * 3, 30, 450);
485	      }
486	      if (t1Dead && rnd(mv4) === 0) {
487	        const ang = Math.atan2(1, Math.random() * 3) + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.7853982;
488	        shootM(game, e.cx + rndRange(50, 70), e.cy + rndRange(30, 45),
489	          Math.cos(ang) * 3, Math.sin(ang) * 3, 30, 450);
490	      }
491	      // 火炮空巢（:36261-36276）:上方侧向抛射
492	      if (c0Dead && rnd(mv5) === 0) {
493	        const ang = Math.atan2(-1, -Math.random() * 2) + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.7853982;
494	        shootM(game, e.cx - rndRange(30, 60), e.cy + rndRange(-30, -10),
495	          Math.cos(ang) * 3, Math.sin(ang) * 3, 30, 450);
496	      }
497	      if (c1Dead && rnd(mv5) === 0) {
498	        const ang = Math.atan2(-1, Math.random() * 2) + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.7853982;
499	        shootM(game, e.cx + rndRange(30, 60), e.cy + rndRange(-30, -10),
500	          Math.cos(ang) * 3, Math.sin(ang) * 3, 30, 450);
501	      }
502	    }
503	  }
504	}

506	// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
507	// AI_074 火星无人机 388 + 日耀 Corite 418（NPC.cs:35452-35744,参数表 :35477-35509）
508	// ai[0] 0=悬浮瞄准(LOS+俯角+距离带 → 锁方向) / 1=蓄力(×0.95,30t) / 2=扑咬(steer 追击) /
509	//        3=自爆(388 专属:64px 贴身或撞块;3t 后炸) / 4=418 扑后恢复
510	// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
511	export function martianDroneAI(e: Enemy, game: GameHooks, player: Player | null) {
512	  const corite = e.vanillaId === 418;
513	  if (!e.bInit) { e.bInit = true; e.ai0 = 0; e.ai1 = 0; e.ai2 = 0; e.ai3 = 0; }
514	  // 参数表（:35477-35509）：388 / 418
515	  const kbMult = corite ? 0.3 : 0.4;
516	  const spd = corite ? 8 : 10;
517	  const hover = corite ? 175 : 200;
518	  const near = corite ? 175 : 0;
519	  const far = corite ? 600 : 750;
520	  const minNear = corite ? 80 : 0;
521	  const accel = corite ? 60 : 30;
522	  const windup = corite ? 20 : 30;
523	  const decay = corite ? 0.75 : 0.95;
524	  const jitter = corite ? 0 : 50;
525	  const dashSpd = corite ? 9 : 14;
526	  const steerN = corite ? 60 : 20;
527	  const steerAcc = corite ? (4 / 15) * 60 : 0;
528	  const minSpd = 7;
529	  const canExplode = !corite;   // flag68（:35491）
530	
531	  // 朝向（:35454-35469）
532	  if (sign(e.vx) !== 0) e.facing = corite ? sign(e.vx) : -sign(e.vx);
533	
534	  if (e.ai0 === 0 && player && !player.dead) {
535	    // ---- 悬浮瞄准（:35540-35610）----
536	    e.def.knockbackResist = kbMult;    // GetKnockbackMultiplier_ScaledByDifficulty
537	    const dx0 = player.cx - e.cx, dy0 = player.cy - e.cy;
538	    const dist = Math.hypot(dx0, dy0);
539	    // 悬停航向（:35546-35552）：直连向量 - 上方 hover - 侧移 near,归一 × spd
540	    const hx = dx0 + (dx0 < 0 ? near : -near), hy = dy0 - hover;
541	    const hd = Math.hypot(hx, hy) || 1;
542	    const vxT = (hx / hd) * spd, vyT = (hy / hd) * spd;
543	    let canHit = losClear(game, e.cx, e.cy, player.cx, player.cy);
544	    if (e.ai3 >= 120) canHit = true;                     // :35556-35558
545	    const aimAng = Math.atan2(dy0, dx0);
546	    const angleOk = aimAng > Math.PI / 8 && aimAng < Math.PI - Math.PI / 8;
547	    const tooNear = dist < minNear, tooFar = dist > far;
548	    if (tooNear || tooFar || !canHit || !angleOk) {
549	      // 悬停逼近（:35564-35583）
550	      e.vx = (e.vx * (accel - 1) + vxT) / accel;
551	      e.vy = (e.vy * (accel - 1) + vyT) / accel;
552	      if (!canHit) {
553	        if (!tooNear && !tooFar) e.ai3 += 1;
554	      } else e.ai3 = 0;
555	    } else {
556	      // 锁定扑咬方向（:35585-35591）
557	      e.ai0 = 1; e.ai1 = 0;
558	      e.ai2 = (dx0 / (dist || 1)) * spd;
559	      e.ai3 = (dy0 / (dist || 1)) * spd;
560	    }
561	  } else if (e.ai0 === 1) {
562	    // ---- 蓄力（:35592-35617）----
563	    e.def.knockbackResist = 0;
564	    let keep = true;
565	    if (corite) {
566	      keep = Math.hypot(e.vx, e.vy) > 2;
567	      if (!keep && player && !player.dead) {
568	        const d = Math.hypot(player.cx - e.cx, player.cy - e.cy) || 1;
569	        e.vx = lerp(e.vx, ((player.cx - e.cx) / d) * 0.1, 0.25);
570	        e.vy = lerp(e.vy, ((player.cy - e.cy) / d) * 0.1, 0.25);
571	      }
572	    }
573	    if (keep) { e.vx *= decay; e.vy *= decay; }
574	    e.ai1 += 1;
575	    if (e.ai1 >= windup) {
576	      e.ai0 = 2; e.ai1 = 0;
577	      let dx = e.ai2 + rndRange(-jitter, jitter + 1) * 0.04;
578	      let dy = e.ai3 + rndRange(-jitter, jitter + 1) * 0.04;
579	      const d = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
580	      dx = (dx / (d || 1)) * dashSpd; dy = (dy / (d || 1)) * dashSpd;
581	      e.vx = dx; e.vy = dy;
582	    }
583	  } else if (e.ai0 === 2) {
584	    // ---- 扑咬（:35618-35659）----
585	    e.def.knockbackResist = 0;
586	    e.ai1 += 1;
587	    const farBelow = player && !player.dead
588	      && Math.hypot(player.cx - e.cx, player.cy - e.cy) > (corite ? 150 : 100)
589	      && e.cy > player.cy;
590	    if ((e.ai1 >= 30 && farBelow) || Math.hypot(e.vx, e.vy) < minSpd) {
591	      e.ai0 = corite ? 4 : 0; e.ai1 = corite ? 45 : 0;
592	      e.ai2 = 0; e.ai3 = 0;
593	      e.vx /= 2; e.vy /= 2;
594	    } else if (player) {
595	      const d = Math.hypot(player.cx - e.cx, player.cy - e.cy) || 1;
596	      const ux = (player.cx - e.cx) / d, uy = (player.cy - e.cy) / d;
597	      const spdNow = Math.hypot(e.vx, e.vy);
598	      e.vx = (e.vx * (steerN - 1) + ux * (spdNow + steerAcc)) / steerN;
599	      e.vy = (e.vy * (steerN - 1) + uy * (spdNow + steerAcc)) / steerN;
600	    }
601	    // 撞块自爆（:35650-35656,仅 388）
602	    if (canExplode) {
603	      const st = game.world.store;
604	      const x0 = Math.floor(e.x / TILE), x1 = Math.floor((e.x + e.w - 0.01) / TILE);
605	      const y0 = Math.floor(e.y / TILE), y1 = Math.floor((e.y + e.h - 0.01) / TILE);
606	      outer: for (let tx = x0; tx <= x1; tx++) {
607	        for (let ty = y0; ty <= y1; ty++) {
608	          if (tx >= 0 && ty >= 0 && tx < st.w && ty < st.h && st.isSolid(tx, ty)) {
609	            e.ai0 = 3; e.ai1 = 0; e.ai2 = 0; e.ai3 = 0;
610	            break outer;
611	          }
612	        }
613	      }
614	    }
615	  } else if (e.ai0 === 4) {
616	    // ---- 418 扑后恢复（:35660-35668）----
617	    e.ai1 -= 3;
618	    if (e.ai1 <= 0) { e.ai0 = 0; e.ai1 = 0; }
619	    e.vx *= 0.95; e.vy *= 0.95;
620	  }
621	  // 贴身自爆（:35670-35678,仅 388:64px 内）
622	  if (canExplode && e.ai0 !== 3 && player && !player.dead
623	    && Math.hypot(player.cx - e.cx, player.cy - e.cy) < 64) {
624	    e.ai0 = 3; e.ai1 = 0; e.ai2 = 0; e.ai3 = 0;
625	  }
626	  if (e.ai0 === 3) {
627	    // ---- 自爆演出（:35680-35735）：原地膨胀 192×192,3t 后爆炸消散 ----
628	    const cx = e.cx, cy = e.cy;
629	    e.x = cx - 96; e.y = cy - 96;
630	    e.w = 192; e.h = 192;
631	    e.vx = 0; e.vy = 0;
632	    e.def.damage = 80;                 // GetAttackDamage_ScaledByDifficulty(80)
633	    e.spawnAlpha = 255;
634	    e.lightRGB = [0.2, 0.7, 1.1];
635	    game.spawnParticles(cx, cy, '#6FD7FF', 6, 2.4, { life: 30 });
636	    e.ai1 += 1;
637	    if (e.ai1 >= 3) {
638	      game.playSfx('explosion', 1, cx, cy);   // SoundID.Item14
639	      e.iframes = 0;
640	      e.hp = 0;
641	      e.hurt(9999, 0, 0, game);
642	    }
643	    return;
644	  }
645	  // aiStyle 74 常态无 AddLight（:35452-35580 全块无点光——曾挂 [0.1,0.4,0.6] 造假常光）
646	  fly(e);
647	}

649	// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
650	// AI_073 特斯拉炮塔 387（NPC.cs:35340-35451）
651	// ai[1] <120 = 部署（60-120t 渐显,alpha 255→0,部署期无敌）;ai[0] 电击计时:
652	//   <60 递增,受击 -30;==60 → 放电 435(伤 35,速 14,±100px 抖动) 并置 -120 → 180t 循环
653	// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
654	export function teslaTurretAI(e: Enemy, game: GameHooks, player: Player | null) {
655	  if (!e.bInit) { e.bInit = true; e.ai0 = 0; e.ai1 = 0; }   // 原版 ai[0] 自 0 起 → 首射 60t
656	  if (player && !player.dead) e.facing = player.cx >= e.cx ? 1 : -1;
657	  // 地面摩擦（:35343-35349）
658	  e.vx *= 0.93;
659	  if (e.vx > -0.1 && e.vx < 0.1) e.vx = 0;
660	
661	  if (e.ai1 < 120) {
662	    // ---- 部署（:35353-35401）：渐显 + 部署期无敌 + 环绕尘 ----
663	    e.ai1 += 1;
664	    e.spawnAlpha = e.ai1 > 60 ? Math.round((1 - (e.ai1 - 60) / 60) * 255) : 255;
665	    e.iframes = 2;                       // dontTakeDamage = true
666	    if (e.ai1 % 6 === 0) {
667	      game.spawnParticles(e.cx, e.cy, '#6FD7FF', 1, 0.6, { life: 20 });
668	    }
669	    e.lightRGB = [0.1 * (e.ai1 / 60), 0.5 * (e.ai1 / 60), 0.7 * (e.ai1 / 60)];
670	    e.lightRGBAt = { x: e.cx, y: e.cy - 10 };   // :35404 光源 = Center.Y−10
671	    e.vy = Math.min(e.vy + GRAVITY, MAX_FALL_SPEED);
```

```
Note also vanilla: `ai[1] += 1; if (!(ai[1] >= 30)) break;` — the 30t gate comes BEFORE the rest (our code `if (e.ai1 >= 30)` matches).

- dd2-walker tests re: targeting (aggro steal), ogre cooldown.
- lategame tests re: empress table.
```

```json
 "new_string": "/** Collision.SolidCollision(px 盒与实心块相交；Collision.cs:2748-2791)：\n *  flag = tileSolid && !tileSolidTop；acceptTopSurfaces=true 时并入\"可站顶面\"\n *  （平台族 + 家具底行，本仓 isPlatform 语义）与半砖（y+8 高 8 的 AABB） */\nfunction solidCollisionPx(game: GameHooks, x: number, y: number, w: number, h: number,\n  acceptTopSurfaces = false): boolean {\n  const st = game.world.store;\n  const i0 = Math.floor(x / TILE), j0 = Math.floor(y / TILE);\n  const i1 = Math.floor((x + w - 0.01) / TILE), j1 = Math.floor((y + h - 0.01) / TILE);\n  for (let i = i0; i <= i1; i++) {\n    for (let j = j0; j <= j1; j++) {\n      if (!st.inBounds(i, j)) continue;\n      const idx = st.idx(i, j);\n      if (st.flags[idx] === 0) continue;               // !active\n      let solid = st.isSolid(i, j) && !st.isPlatform(i, j);\n      if (acceptTopSurfaces && st.isPlatform(i, j)) solid = true;\n      if (!solid) continue;\n      let ty = j * TILE, th = TILE;\n      if (st.half[idx]) { ty += 8; th -= 8; }          // 半砖（:2778-2782）\n      if (x + w > i * TILE && x < i * TILE + TILE && y + h > ty && y < ty + th) return true;\n    }\n  }\n  return false;\n}"
}
```

````
  const aggro = player && !player.dead ? (player as {aggro?: number}).aggro ?? 0 : 0;

  }

}
````

```
import { Enemy } from '../src/entities/Enemy';
import { Player } from '../src/entities/Player';
import { Inventory } from '../src/items/Inventory';
import { World } from '../src/world/World';
import { TILE } from '../src/core/constants';
import type { GameHooks } from '../src/entities/types';

const W = 160, H = 120, FLOOR = 100;

function makeWorld(): World {
  const w = new World(W, H, 7, 'icequeen-sim');
  const st = w.store;
  w.groundLevel = 50;
  for (let x = 0; x < W; x++) {
    st.setTile(x, FLOOR, 1);
    st.setTile(x, FLOOR + 1, 1);
  }
  w.clock.timeOfDay = 0.9; // 夜间（isDay = 0.25..0.75 之外）
  return w;
}

describe('冰女王敌弹命中玩家（端到端）', () => {

    const enemies: Enemy[] = [];
    const projectiles: Array<{ fixedUpdate: (dt: number, g: GameHooks) => void; dead: boolean }> = [];
    const em = {
      nextId: 1,
      add: (e: unknown, bucket: string) => {
        const ent = e as { id: number };
        ent.id = em.nextId++;
        if (bucket === 'enemies') enemies.push(e as Enemy);
        else projectiles.push(e as typeof projectiles[number]);
      },
    };
    const hooks = {
      world, player: p, entities: em,
      enemies: () => enemies,
      critters: () => [],
      spawnDrop: () => null,
      damagePlayer: (dmg: number, sx: number, sy: number) => { hits.push(dmg); p.damage(dmg, sx, sy); },
      addDamageNumber: () => {},
      cutTile: () => {},
      onEnemyKilled: () => {},
      spawnEnemy: () => {},
      spawnParticles: () => {},
      notifyInventoryChanged: () => {},
      playSfx: () => {},
```
